authority: Decisions of Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026, items A2, A4, A5 and B10, recorded in validation/DECISIONS_2026-08-22.json
aligned_with: A Computational Theory of Cognitive Memory V4.7
rule: Internal metric keys and file column names remain unchanged for compatibility. All protocols, reports, figures and manuscripts use the canonical names below. This mirrors the parent release's own public/terminology_v0_5_1.json convention.

audit conformity.reserved_for: Theory equation (36): AuditConformant_t = 1 iff the realised lifecycle trace matches the independently specified frozen reference certificate AND no critical violation is present.
audit conformity.must_not_be_used_for: any outcome of this audit extension
audit conformity.reason: This extension is oracle independent by design and has no reference certificate to match against. It measures the rung below in the theory's own ordering: audit-ready, evaluable, functionally auditable, audit-conformant.
audit conformity.decision: B10, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: USE RECONSTRUCTIBILITY AND COHERENCE, RESERVE AUDIT CONFORMITY FOR LIFECYCLE CERTIFICATE TEST.

reconstructibility.definition: Records whose pathway could be reconstructed, over expected records. A case counts when its status is CONFORMANT, INCOMPLETE or NONCONFORMANT: the pathway was reconstructible even where it carried a defect.
reconstructibility.renamed_because: The protocol's section 13 metric and the Level 1 headline outcome would otherwise both be called reconstructibility. The theory already names this rung.

conformity_at_L1_IO.definition: Cases whose input-output pathway reconstructs with no defect, over expected cases.

conformity_at_L2.definition: Cases whose retained cognitive-trace object is internally coherent with no defect, over expected cases.

critical_rate.definition: Records carrying a critical violation, over expected records.

partial_prospective_field_stability.definition: Memories whose three recorded prospective fields are identical between the M0 and B1 objects, over memories. Covers three of the five operands of protocol equation (1).
partial_prospective_field_stability.decision: B6, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: the full non-rewrite claim is withdrawn on this parent release.

delta_IO_B1_minus_B0.canonical_name: Trace-reconstructibility difference, cognitive memory minus raw longitudinal evidence
delta_IO_B1_minus_B0.decision: A2, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: declared an instrument-integrity endpoint, not a discriminating one.
delta_IO_B1_minus_B0.reporting_requirement: The ceiling must be stated explicitly. Deterministic Level 1 outcome sits at 97.5-100 percent in every condition, because the public response schema has four fields and the frozen runner already rejects schema-invalid responses. Read it as evidence that the retained artefacts support reconstruction in every condition.

delta_IO_M0_minus_B0.canonical_name: Trace-reconstructibility difference, pre-specified consequence mapping minus raw longitudinal evidence

delta_Trace_B1_minus_M0.decision: A4, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: RELEASE-INTEGRITY NOW, EXTEND SCHEMA AS FOLLOW-ON. Protocol equation (7) is withdrawn from the confirmatory set.
delta_Trace_B1_minus_M0.reason: The release has no trace-writing path, so the contrast compares a dataset property that is invariant across all five contexts, all three renderings and every model.
delta_Trace_B1_minus_M0.reporting_requirement: Report Level 2 once for the release as a release-integrity audit, not as a per-condition contrast. If the difference is shown at all, it must be labelled withdrawn and descriptive.

SCOPED.definition: Canonical fields the parent release does not record are recorded as NOT_RECORDED_IN_SOURCE_RELEASE and excluded from the outcome.

LITERAL.definition: Canonical fields the parent release does not record count as missing mandatory components.
LITERAL.decision: A5, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: LITERAL AS SENSITIVITY ONLY.
LITERAL.reporting_requirement: Must never appear as a headline figure. Report as a declared sensitivity analysis.

deterministic_only_upper_bound.text: Every outcome reported here is a deterministic-only figure and therefore an upper bound. Four human-detected codes are inert pending a frozen rubric and E2_SCOPE_OVERREACH is scored by its automated half only; adding the human layer can only lower these figures, never raise them.
deterministic_only_upper_bound.decision: B8, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: RATIFY, CURRENT RESULTS ARE DETERMINISTIC-ONLY UPPER BOUNDS.

cluster_coverage.text: Memory-clustered bootstrap intervals under-cover at these cluster counts. The parent release's own coverage study puts 8-cluster coverage near 89.6 percent and 32-cluster coverage near 92.5 percent against a nominal 95 percent. Every audit interval carries the same disclosure the decision results carry.

level1_ceiling.text: Level 1 sits at a ceiling by construction on this parent release and is reported as an instrument-integrity endpoint.

structural_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_DESIGN: B0 has no persistent cognitive-trace object. Its Level 2 status is not incomplete and not failed.
structural_statuses.OPEN_LOOP_BY_CONDITION_DESIGN: M0 records no evidence-resolved consequence. Absent closure is the condition's content, not an error.
structural_statuses.UNRESOLVED_BY_CONDITION_DESIGN: The retained relation positively represents unresolvedness. Absent constitutive evidence is that relation's content, not an error.
structural_statuses.NOT_RECORDED_IN_SOURCE_RELEASE: The parent release records no such field. Never inferred.
structural_statuses.NOT_EVALUABLE_FROM_SOURCE_RELEASE: The parent release declares the field but states no expectation against which it could be evaluated.
